canonical_statement: The universe's expansion and dark energy can be modeled using entropic cosmology, which is equivalent to teleparallel gravity.

attributions.surface_quote: Entropic cosmology... is equivalent to cosmology based on the teleparallel gravity.

canonical_statement: The thermodynamics-gravity correspondence allows for the investigation of dark energy models.

attributions.surface_quote: By virtue of the thermodynamics-gravity correspondence a model of dark energy is investigated.

canonical_statement: The late-time acceleration of the universe can be described through the thermodynamics-gravity correspondence.

attributions.surface_quote: Making use of the thermodynamics-gravity correspondence, we describe the late time of the universe acceleration.

canonical_statement: The apparent horizon radius in a spatially flat FLRW spacetime coincides with the Hubble radius.

attributions.surface_quote: apparent horizon radius coincides with the Hubble radius

canonical_statement: The Hubble radius is the distance at which cosmic expansion causes objects to recede at the speed of light.

attributions.surface_quote: Hubble radius which is the distance from an observer where the expansion of the universe causes objects to recede at the speed of light

canonical_statement: The first law of apparent horizon thermodynamics can be used to derive the Friedmann equation within entropic cosmology.

attributions.surface_quote: To obtain the Friedmann equation within entropic cosmology we consider the first law of apparent horizon thermodynamics

canonical_statement: The Rényi entropy represents a deformation of the Bekenstein–Hawking entropy.

attributions.surface_quote: The Rényi entropy (7) represents the deformation of the BH entropy.

canonical_statement: Corrections to the Bekenstein–Hawking entropy decrease the Rényi entropy.

attributions.surface_quote: corrections to the BH entropy SBH decrease the SR entropy.

canonical_statement: The Rényi entropy can mimic quantum gravity corrections to Bekenstein–Hawking entropy.

attributions.surface_quote: One can assume that entropy (7) mimics the quantum gravity corrections to SBH entropy.
